observations: Photo 0: Laptop open, screen on, showing Windows 10/11 default blue wallpaper. HP logo visible on lower bezel. Background has a lit 'JAYSMART' sign.
Photo 1: Laptop closed, showing back lid with HP logo. Surface appears dusty or smudged. Same 'JAYSMART' sign in background.
Photo 2: Laptop partially open, screen dark, keyboard visible. Side vents and ports partially visible. Same background sign.
All photos show the same laptop from different angles, placed on a stand or another device. No visible model label or serial number.
No clear view of the bottom chassis, ports, or internal components.
No visible damage to screen or casing, but surface dirt/smudges present.

claims.evidence: No model label visible in any photo. HP logo is visible, but model name is not readable. Seller's text is not proof.

claims.claim: processor speed: Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-6200U CPU...
claims.evidence: No system information visible in photos. Cannot verify CPU from images alone.

risks.risk: The laptop may not be the claimed model (HP Probook 430 g3)
risks.proof: Photo of the bottom chassis or a clear shot of the model label (usually near hinge or on underside).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic HP laptop, not as a Probook 430 g3.

risks.risk: The CPU may not be an Intel Core i5-6200U
risks.proof: Screenshot of system information (e.g., Windows 'About' page or CPU-Z) or a clear shot of the BIOS/UEFI screen showing CPU details.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a laptop with unknown processor, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Screen may have dead pixels, cracks, or backlight issues not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Video of screen displaying full white, full black, and color gradients, or a close-up photo of the screen under bright light.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as screen condition unknown, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Battery may be degraded or non-functional.
risks.proof: Video showing battery charge level and usage time, or a photo of the battery health report.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as battery condition unknown, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Internal components (RAM, SSD/HDD) may be missing or faulty.
risks.proof: Photo of open laptop showing internal components or a screenshot of disk management and system info.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as internal specs unknown, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Photo of the bottom chassis showing the model label.
Screenshot of system information (Windows 'About' page or CPU-Z).
Video of screen displaying full white, full black, and color gradients.
Video showing battery charge level and usage time.
Photo of internal components or screenshot of disk management.
response.reason: The model and processor claims cannot be verified from the current photos. Without proof of the model and specs, the item cannot be accurately priced. The risks of misrepresentation or hidden defects are significant and must be resolved before pricing.
